integrity: Explicit analytical proof is accompanied by standalone finite-graph cross-checks; independent external audit or certification has not occurred. Closest literature and residual originality uncertainty are documented.
limitations: The result concerns a two-point antipodal real-scalar Dirichlet trace on the unweighted Boolean cube, with Hamming graph distance. It measures the norm of the specific variational p-energy minimizer, not the optimal norm among all linear extensions. The classical quadratic effective-resistance case, variational p-voltages, and continuum dimension-sensitive transitions are prior art. Other metrics, label sets and targets are unproved.
title: Exact Lipschitz amplification and dimension–exponent crossover for antipodal hypercube \(p\)-energy interpolation
